description: ADIRF AlphaFold secondary/tertiary analysis plus four-panel sorting-signal summary figure
code:
import numpy as np, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SEQ = "MASKGLQDLKQQVEGTAQEAVSAAGAAAQQVVDQATEAGQKAMDQLAKTTQETIDKTANQASDTFSGIGKKFGLLK"
af = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q15847", timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb = requests.get(af["pdbUrl"], timeout=60).text
atoms={}; plddt=[]; xyz=[]
for line in pdb.splitlines():
    if line.startswith("ATOM"):
        n=line[12:16].strip(); ri=int(line[22:26])
        c=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
        atoms.setdefault(ri,{})[n]=c
        if n=="CA": plddt.append(float(line[60:66])); xyz.append(c)
plddt=np.array(plddt); xyz=np.array(xyz)

def dihe(p0,p1,p2,p3):
    b0=p0-p1; b1=p2-p1; b2=p3-p2; b1=b1/np.linalg.norm(b1)
    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1)*b1; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1)*b1
    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(b1,v),w), np.dot(v,w)))
pp=[]
for i in range(2,76):
    pp.append((i, dihe(atoms[i-1]['C'],atoms[i]['N'],atoms[i]['CA'],atoms[i]['C']),
                  dihe(atoms[i]['N'],atoms[i]['CA'],atoms[i]['C'],atoms[i+1]['N'])))
hel=[i for i,phi,psi in pp if -100<phi<-30 and -80<psi<-5]
beta=[i for i,phi,psi in pp if -180<phi<-45 and (psi>90 or psi<-150)]
def runs(xs):
    out=[];s=xs[0];p=xs[0]
    for x in xs[1:]:
        if x==p+1: p=x
        else: out.append((s,p)); s=x;p=x
    out.append((s,p)); return out
print(f"alpha-helical (phi,psi): {len(hel)}/{len(pp)} = {100*len(hel)/len(pp):.0f}%")
print("helical segments >=4 res:", [r for r in runs(hel) if r[1]-r[0]>=3])
print("beta-basin residues:", len(beta))
D=np.linalg.norm(xyz[:,None,:]-xyz[None,:,:],axis=-1)
lr=[(i+1,j+1,round(float(D[i,j]),1)) for i in range(76) for j in range(i+7,76) if D[i,j]<8]
print(f"long-range CA-CA contacts (<8A, |i-j|>6): {len(lr)} -> {lr if lr else 'NONE: no tertiary packing, no hydrophobic core'}")
print(f"mean i,i+4 CA dist = {np.mean([D[i,i+4] for i in range(72)]):.2f} A (ideal alpha-helix 6.2)")
rg=np.sqrt(((xyz-xyz.mean(0))**2).sum(1).mean())
print(f"Rg={rg:.1f} A | end-to-end={np.linalg.norm(xyz[0]-xyz[-1]):.1f} A | folded-globular expectation {2.2*76**0.38:.1f} A")
print(f"mean pLDDT {plddt.mean():.1f}; res 1-50 mean {plddt[:50].mean():.1f}; res 51-76 mean {plddt[50:].mean():.1f}")

kdv=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
eis=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
kp=lambda w: np.array([np.mean([kdv[a] for a in SEQ[i:i+w]]) for i in range(76-w+1)])
def hmom(s,d=100.0):
    a=np.deg2rad(d*np.arange(len(s))); h=np.array([eis[x] for x in s])
    return np.sqrt((h*np.cos(a)).sum()**2+(h*np.sin(a)).sum()**2)/len(s)
p19,p9=kp(19),kp(9); W=18
mu=np.array([hmom(SEQ[i:i+W]) for i in range(76-W+1)])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(4,1,figsize=(11,11.5),sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(np.arange(len(p19))+10,p19,color='#2b6cb0',lw=2,label='Kyte-Doolittle, window 19 (TM scan)')
ax[0].plot(np.arange(len(p9))+5,p9,color='#90cdf4',lw=1.5,label='Kyte-Doolittle, window 9')
ax[0].axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='#c53030'); ax[0].text(1,1.72,'threshold for a TM helix or a signal-peptide h-region (~1.6)',c='#c53030',fontsize=9)
ax[0].axhline(0,c='k',lw=.6); ax[0].set_ylabel('hydropathy'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
ax[0].set_title('ADIRF (UniProt Q15847, 76 aa): sorting-signal scan and AlphaFold model',fontsize=12)
ax[1].plot(np.arange(len(mu))+W//2,mu,color='#2f855a',lw=2)
ax[1].axhspan(0.20,0.50,color='#9ae6b4',alpha=.45)
ax[1].text(1,0.53,'range of lipid-binding amphipathic helices',fontsize=9,c='#22543d')
ax[1].set_ylabel('Eisenberg <$\\mu_H$>\n18-mer, 100°/residue'); ax[1].set_ylim(0,0.75)
dens=np.array([sum(1 for a in SEQ[max(0,i-2):i+4] if a in 'KR') for i in range(76)])
ax[2].bar(np.arange(1,77),dens,color='#805ad5',width=.9)
ax[2].axhline(4,ls='--',c='#c53030'); ax[2].text(1,4.15,'basic density needed for a classical monopartite NLS',c='#c53030',fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_ylabel('K/R per\n6-residue window'); ax[2].set_ylim(0,5.5)
ax[3].plot(np.arange(1,77),plddt,color='#dd6b20',lw=2)
for y,l in [(90,'very high'),(70,'confident'),(50,'low')]:
    ax[3].axhline(y,ls=':',c='gray'); ax[3].text(77.2,y+1,l,fontsize=8,c='gray')
ax[3].set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT'); ax[3].set_xlabel('residue position')
ax[3].annotate('one continuous $\\alpha$-helix, zero long-range contacts\n($R_g$ 31.9 Å, end-to-end 108 Å, no hydrophobic core)',
               xy=(28,90),xytext=(26,30),fontsize=9,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='#dd6b20'))
for a in ax: a.set_xlim(0,82); a.grid(alpha=.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
